---
name: Printer report
about: A Bambu printer or AMS the kit doesn't recognise yet, or slot mapping that failed
title: "Printer report: <your printer model>"
labels: printer-report
---

Attach the report file here. Make it with **Collect a report** (the Android app's printer screen, the phone web app's
printer page or the setup page's Printers tab), or at the server:

    sudo filament-kit printer report <serial>

**Before you attach it, open it and read it.** It's a short XML file, built so it holds no serial, address, printer name,
account id or spool identity. If you see anything of yours in it, don't attach it; say so here instead, because that's a bug.
